name: GD Optimizer
description: Lightweight CPU and GPU optimizer for Geometry Dash 2.2081.

auto-ldm.name: Auto LDM
auto-ldm.description: Forces Low Detail Mode on all levels automatically.

strip-high-detail-deco.name: Strip High-Detail Deco
strip-high-detail-deco.description: Skips loading decoration objects marked as High Detail to save CPU.

disable-particles.name: Disable Particles
disable-particles.description: Stops particle emission and skips rendering particle quads.

disable-glow.name: Disable Object Glow
disable-glow.description: Hides glow sprites on level objects to reduce draw overhead.

disable-death-effect.name: Disable Death Effect
disable-death-effect.description: Removes death explosion particles to prevent lag spikes on death.

hide-background.name: Hide Level Background
hide-background.description: Hides the level background sprite to save GPU fillrate.

high-cpu-priority.name: High CPU Priority (Windows)
high-cpu-priority.description: Sets GeometryDash.exe process priority to High.
